counsellor.title: Counsellor dashboard
counsellor.subtitle: Only students who have given you an active, unexpired care share appear here.
counsellor.auditNotice: Each time you open a student's data, an entry is written to an append-only audit log that the student can see. Open only what you need for care.
counsellor.loadError: We could not load your dashboard. Please try again.
counsellor.notCounsellor: This dashboard is only for verified counsellors.
counsellor.caseloadEmpty: No students have shared data with you yet. Students choose what to share and can withdraw at any time.
counsellor.trajectoryIntro: PHQ-9 and GAD-7 are educational self-assessments the student chose to share. They are not diagnoses.
counsellor.trajectoryError: We could not load assessments. The student may not have shared this scope.
counsellor.riskLiveOff: Live updates are unavailable. Refresh to check again.
counsellor.riskError: We could not load the risk queue.
counsellor.bannerText: In-app alerts only. This is not monitored 24/7. If a student may be in immediate danger, use emergency services.
counsellor.overdueDetail: No one has acknowledged this within {{hours}} hours.
counsellor.reopened: The student asked to talk in a check-back
counsellor.offlineLine: Detected {{detected}} while the student was offline, received {{received}}
counsellor.closureRequired: Choose a closure reason to close this event.
counsellor.noteWarning: Do not write what the student said or wrote. Record only your own actions.
counsellor.advanceError: We could not save that step. Check your care share and the order of steps, then try again.
counsellor.offerNoSlots: No upcoming unbooked availability slots found.
counsellor.offerError: We could not offer that slot. Check your care share and slot availability, then try again.
counsellor.notesIntro: Notes are encrypted in your browser with your own vault passphrase. The server stores only ciphertext.
counsellor.noteAppointmentNone: No appointments with this student yet.
counsellor.noteError: We could not save the note.
counsellor.noteLoadError: We could not decrypt your notes with this passphrase.
counsellor.noteEmpty: No notes for this student yet.
counsellor.noteFetchError: We could not load the saved notes. They have not been deleted. Please try again.
